speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A year to the day. Tonight is the old play, once. I am not playing it twice to improve it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Morning prayer has kept its place. The night is the command, and it is the one Sunday. I am not adding a gloss for the room.

speaker: will_kemp
text: At Greenwich last Christmas there was a dog, and if I were allowed the length of him.

speaker: george_bryan
text: She heard the dog at Greenwich. One does not tell her Majesty the same dog twice.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then the dog stays at Greenwich. I can hold a beast as well as a button. You will not have me sad about it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The old play, once. I know which twin is which from the other pair, and I am not rehearsing the difference over bread.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nick stays under the note if he is on at all. Happiness is still not a licence. A Sunday command is not a jig, not until a man with a staff says it is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He is not spending a note this morning. I give Egeon's tale, the long one, to a hall that will have cups in its hands. Then I am behind the traverse. I am not rehearsing my nerves at this table.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Good. Give the tale and come off. A man who practises his fear makes the fear a part. I will be where the plot puts me.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No book this morning. Three nights are three nights, and none of them is a receipt. If my lord is content he will send a man. He has not sent one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we do not invent his content. Cups in their hands is a hall, not a wage.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I will not play a twin as a complaint about courts. The confusion is the play. The hall may laugh. I am not going to help it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I laugh when a thing is laughable. You made it younger than you are, Will. A young thing may be laughed at without a funeral.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And without a dog. The old play is the play we named. I am not explaining it again, at a table, to a man who has already heard the reason.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam carries what I give him. He is not a searcher today. If a thing falls he leaves it where it fell.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The traverse is a cloth. Standing behind it after the tale is the rest of the night. It is not a slight, and I will not let anyone in this room make it one.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Two borrowed cloaks stay on their pegs until there is a yeoman and a light. I am not signing last night's peg a second time in words.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not improve Egeon because I am older than the man who wrote him. The tale is long enough. Once is the command.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Long enough is a mercy. I have stood in short things that felt longer, and I do not want one of them tonight.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I will not tell the dog at the door either. You may have that for nothing. I am saving my mouth.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Save it. The chair does not owe us a second beast, and this table does not owe you a pulpit.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Boys at my heel when we cross tonight. This morning was prayer. Prayer is not a chorus, and yesterday's feast is not a reason to start one.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we are set until the door. I want the tale given clean, and the man who gave it quiet after.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Quiet, and no sum. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. Once. Not twice.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Once. The prayer is done. The table can go back to being a table.
